themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Multiple European countries, including Spain, Italy, and Germany, are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies in response to perceived border crises. This includes demands for stricter controls, deportations, and opposition to EU migration pacts, reflecting a broader transnational trend of securitizing migration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands clarification on relocation of unaccompanied minors from Ceuta to Oviedo, criticizes government for lack of transparency (refs 21, 884, 904).

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticizes Switzerland and Germany for resuming migrant transfers to Italy under Dublin Pact, framing it as a threat to national sovereignty (refs 26, 57, 47, 694).

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls, criticizes government for lax policies, and proposes deportation measures (refs 15, 55, 110, 301).

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes Brexit for worsening small boat crisis, urges UK to rejoin EU migration pact (ref 76).

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Opposes refugee intake and Pride participation, emphasizing national identity and border control (ref 175).

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pushes for stricter EU migration policies, aligning with Italy's Meloni to advocate for harsher measures (ref 197).

signals: shared framing of migration as security threat

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe, including Germany's AfD, Sweden's Sverigedemokraterna, and Italy's Lega, are making significant electoral gains. These parties are leveraging dissatisfaction with mainstream governance, economic instability, and migration issues to consolidate power in regional and national contexts.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with over 40%, poised to become first far-right state premier (refs 15, 55, 110, 301, 302, 510, 547, 791, 858, 934).

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes state-run psychiatric homes, advocates for stricter immigration policies, and gains in polls (refs 144, 221, 284, 812, 838, 852, 1118, 1130).

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal divisions but remains influential in Italian politics, with Salvini's leadership under scrutiny (refs 7, 27, 35, 50, 62, 721, 1041, 1042, 1094, 1095).

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Gains traction in French politics, with Jordan Bardella emerging as a key figure (refs 141, 197, 1092, 1128).

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Gains significant ground in Norwegian elections, particularly among younger voters (refs 54, 179, 276, 622, 1090, 1115).

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in the US, Argentina, and Poland are implementing austerity measures and targeting social programs under the guise of fiscal responsibility. These policies often face criticism for disproportionately affecting vulnerable populations and exacerbating economic inequality.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes cuts to Head Start program, rescinds roadless rule protecting national forests, and imposes tariffs on student visas (refs 19, 36, 52, 72, 77, 81, 89, 95, 100, 164, 172, 190, 193, 218, 306).

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Proposes deportation service and stricter immigration controls, faces criticism for social program cuts (refs 22, 87, 88, 102, 127, 137, 166, 180, 220, 261, 269, 348, 405, 409, 457, 468, 555, 572, 627, 666, 845, 931, 955, 985, 1020, 1034, 1146).

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes significant welfare cuts, faces criticism for targeting vulnerable populations (refs 286, 578, 667, 910, 1040, 1167).

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties in the US, Poland, UK, Spain, and Italy are intensifying attacks on LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies. This includes legislative efforts to restrict gender-affirming care, reverse cultural diversity policies, and dismantle gender-focused government programs.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Targets gender-affirming care, proposes changes to federal programs affecting LGBTQ+ communities (refs 19, 36, 40, 52, 70, 190, 306, 396, 551, 623).

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Targets LGBTQ+ rights, implements policies restricting gender and sexual orientation discussions (refs 40, 109, 323, 843, 959).

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Opposes LGBTQ+ rights, uses anti-trans rhetoric, and faces criticism for discriminatory policies (refs 286, 383, 667, 714, 800).

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Targets gender policies, opposes diversity initiatives, and faces criticism for anti-LGBTQ+ stances (refs 194, 231, 401, 461, 502, 628, 630, 892, 1053).

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Targets gender policies, dismantles diversity initiatives, and faces criticism for anti-LGBTQ+ stances (refs 40, 109, 591, 755, 1021).
